scripts.setup: npm run install-deps && npm run setup-db
scripts.install-deps: npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup-db: npm run backend:makemigrations && npm run backend:migrate
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py runserver
scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py migrate
scripts.backend:makemigrations: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py makemigrations
scripts.backend:createsuperuser: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py createsuperuser
scripts.test: npm run frontend:test && npm run backend:test
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py test
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/venv backend/__pycache__ backend/pageviews/__pycache__ backend/portfolio_backend/__pycache__
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup
